name: FarmDash Camp Guard
description: Use for pre-sign safety: allowance audits, route/health sentinel checks, policy scan of unsigned transactions. Verdicts only; never signs or broadcasts.
author: FarmDash Pioneers (@Parmasanandgarlic)

tools.name: audit_allowance_risk
tools.description: Use this when a wallet has existing or proposed ERC20 approvals.

spenderVerified.description: True only after independent verification against the protocol canonical deployment.

outputHints: `flags`: approval risks such as unlimited allowance, unknown spender, or large dollar exposure.
`requiresUserConfirmation`: true unless the verdict is clean.

tools.name: simulate_transaction_risk
tools.description: Applies transaction policy checks to an unsigned transaction.

tools.name: run_risk_sentinel
tools.description: Analyze compatibility-swap risk using the active provider quote boundary, allowance state, depeg checks, health factors, and positive-net-edge enforcement. x402 is machine-payment/access infrastructure, not a swap provider. Risk analysis does not authorize, broadcast, confirm, or settle a transaction.

fromToken.description: ERC-20 token contract address deployed on the corresponding chain. Do not pass a wallet/EOA; the token address and chain ID must match.

toToken.description: ERC-20 token contract address deployed on the corresponding chain. Do not pass a wallet/EOA; the token address and chain ID must match.

operatingRules: A critical flag means stop. Do not continue to signing.
A high flag means present the issue and require explicit user confirmation after remediation.
Never hide approval risk behind expected APY or point farming upside.
Never use referral links inside a risk warning.
Never claim a route is safe because it is popular. Use the returned flags.
A valid EVM address is not a verified spender. Unknown identity is a risk state, not a pass.
Prefer exact or narrowly buffered approvals. More than 20% above `requiredAmount` requires review; more than 10x is high risk.
Compare the final unsigned transaction with an independently captured expected envelope. Any target, chain, value, or calldata-hash mismatch is a halt.
A `pass` means only that these policy checks found no supplied-data violation. It is never a smart-contract audit or RPC simulation.

FARMDASH_API_KEY.description: Optional Bearer token for Pioneer or Syndicate tier. Scout mode can use limited security checks without a key.

spot.USER_SIGNED.prerequisite: Healthy execution governor, quote provider, RPC and durable receipt store; customer signs and submits.

spot.BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS.prerequisite: Owner-signed EVM grant, exact simulation/calldata binding, durable budget and customer-local signer authority.

futures.USER_SIGNED.prerequisite: Venue account ownership, local action signature, builder approval, risk/research gates and durable order control.

futures.BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS.prerequisite: Authenticated owner-bound futures policy, authorized local API-wallet signature, durable nonce/budget/order controls.

solana.USER_SIGNED.prerequisite: Native Jupiter/RPC route, durable preparation and finality store; customer signs and broadcasts.

solana.BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS.prerequisite: Native owner-signed Solana policy; local key must be an actual required transaction signer. Policy creates no on-chain authority.

ERC4337_SERVER_SUBMISSION.prerequisite: Qualified tenant/account authorization and session-key policy enforcement on public forwarding, configured bundler, durable claims and verified receipt integration.

GENERIC_SERVER_INTENT_EXECUTION.prerequisite: Trusted executable adapter, exact signed-transaction binding and canonical receipt verifier.

MEE.prerequisite: Production coordinator and authoritative source/destination receipt verifier.

ACP.prerequisite: AcpReadinessService paidWorkflowReady, evaluator/client identities, migrations, funding/finality workers and Base RPC.

installation_attribution.generation: locally generated random UUIDv4, stable per installation, shared across skills
installation_attribution.authority: none; cannot authenticate, grant quota/payment/trial capacity, own wallets, delegate or sign
